signal_class: label-free structural consistency; not an accuracy estimate
angle_closure: Not implemented. Heading closure is a real constraint but could not be recovered without camera calibration; see the module docstring for the four attempts that failed.

path_length_closure.caveat: Image motion is not distance; it is a monotone proxy whose relation to arc length depends on scene depth. That relation is shared by both runs because it is a property of the road, which is what makes the comparison meaningful, but a large residual localises a problem rather than measuring one in metres.
